blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear, legible text with good definition and minimal blur.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as text is sufficiently sharp for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt displays excellent black text on white background with strong contrast.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed as contrast is optimal for text recognition.

glare_identification.description: The receipt shows minimal glare with consistent lighting across the document.
glare_identification.recommendation: No action needed as lighting conditions are favorable for text extraction.

water_stains.description: No visible water damage, discoloration or staining is present on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: No action needed as document appears clean and undamaged by moisture.

tears_or_folds.description: Minor creasing visible at the top of the receipt but does not impact text legibility.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: No action needed as the minor creasing does not affect text recognition.

cut_off_detection.description: The receipt appears to be completely captured with all content visible within the frame.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: No action needed as all receipt content is properly captured.

missing_sections.description: All standard receipt sections are present including header, line items, subtotals and total amount.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed as receipt appears complete with all essential information visible.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows or other objects obstruct any part of the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: No action needed as there are no obstructions affecting document visibility.
